policy.reason: Physical testing of installed Android 97 and iOS 32 reproduced keyboard obstruction, microphone recovery failures, degraded initial video state, unresolved iPhone route switching and Android shared-track disposal crashes. The next PR #539 candidate repairs call-control keyboard handling, microphone feedback and signaling ownership, deferred camera cancellation and native Android track disposal, and adds bounded startup and route diagnostics. Fresh v7 binaries are required for both platforms, restricted to the existing Google Play and TestFlight internal tester audiences. Installed v6 and earlier cohorts remain immutable. Media diagnostics are enabled only by the two reviewed internal store profiles and matching signed channels; native iOS diagnostics remain restricted to ios-internal-v2. This generation does not authorize OTA publication or public release.
